body:
The worker on task:21241abf8e6ac8a7 filed this as tech debt in note 4. A successful `extract` reply lists every test that stays, which is often hundreds of lines about code the task never touched. That buries the moved symbols and makes the agent read everything again.

### Change

- List what moved by name, as it does now.
- Give the tests that stay as a count.
- Name a staying test only when it's useful: when it reaches both moved and staying code, so its references were rewritten (D-208).

### Done when

- An extract test checks the shorter reply.
- `changing.txt` matches the new reply if it shows one.
- `rust-unit` passes.
title: extract: shorter reply on staying tests
